name: What is the typical process for a seismic upgrade project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a seismic upgrade project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial structural assessment, followed by engineering design for the retrofit. Next, plans are submitted for permitting, and once approved, construction can begin. After construction, a final inspection ensures compliance. Hometelligent Inc. streamlines this process by handling all coordination, from initial consultation to final inspection, ensuring smooth progression for projects in its service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: A seismic upgrade project involves assessment, engineering design, permitting, construction, and final inspection.
